node.title: Import: global hypercontractivity (KLLM) — global sets expand, at vanishing measure
node.statement: Keevash-Lifshitz-Long-Minzer global hypercontractivity (proved): sets with no density boost on any small link expand almost perfectly, with losses polynomial in the link parameters rather than in 1/mu — the density-robust engine for our FM-scale (mu ~ q^{1-t}) regime, replacing raw KMS constants where they degrade. Import note + bridge-ledger row + statement matching.
